Priya Nair: Heads-up — Zebra Corp sent their enterprise security questionnaire and wants an evidence bundle + a short sync next Tue. They specifically called out RBAC change history for service accounts, KMS envelope / rotation proofs for tenant keys, and SIEM ingestion receipts. Can we triage what we can produce by EOW? :eyes:

Alex Kim: I started a quick snaglist. Top-line asks I see in the doc: 1) signed audit log export (seq numbers, timestamps, signatures) 2) KMS key rotation history + envelope metadata 3) IAM change history for service accounts (who granted what and when) 4) proof of SIEM/ELK ingestion (delivery receipts) 5) redaction guarantees for PII/tokens.

Maya Patel: For (1) we can bundle CloudTrail + internal audit events. Need to confirm whether they want token-level redaction or just a redacted export. They asked for "end-to-end chain of custody" which implies a signed manifest + checksums. :+1:

Sam Ortiz: I can run the audit export for their tenant. Proposed command (will produce NDJSON + signed manifest):

```
# run from ops bastion
redwoodctl export-audit --tenant zebra --from 2025-11-01 --to 2025-12-31 --format ndjson --signed --output zebra_audit_2025Q4.ndjson
sha256sum zebra_audit_2025Q4.ndjson > zebra_audit_2025Q4.sha256
```

Alex Kim: Nice. Add a small note to the bundle that we applied token redaction using the standard redact policy v2, and list which event fields were truncated.

Jordan Lee: On the RBAC changes: their ask is specifically about "service-account elevated role changes" over the past 12 months. IAM change events are in the platform-iam index; we can run this query and export the hits. Query snippet: 

```
# ES-ish pseudocode
GET /platform-iam/_search
{"query": {"bool": {"must": [{"term": {"tenant_id": "zebra"}}, {"term": {"resource_type": "service_account"}}, {"range": {"timestamp": {"gte": "now-12M"}}}]}}}
```

Jordan Lee: We should annotate each hit with the operator (who initiated), before/after role bindings, and any linked approval ticket (if exists).

Li Wei: KMS notes: for hosted tenants we can include envelope metadata (key_id, key_version, algorithm, rotation timestamps) and the KMS audit entries that show Encrypt/Decrypt and key version activations. For Dedicated/Private customers we need to include HSM attestation artefacts — ops will need to pull vendor-signed attestation certs (if available). Also confirm whether they want raw ciphertext samples (we should NOT share any raw plaintext).

Maya Patel: They asked for "signed rotation proof" — we typically provide a timeline: create date, rotation dates, key version IDs, and KMS audit records showing version create/disable. That should satisfy most Qs.

Priya Nair: Zebra also wants an incident response example where a service account was suspected of compromise. They want to see detection -> containment -> eradication -> proof (audit timeline). Do we have a sanitized IR playbook example we can include in the bundle?

Sam Ortiz: Yep. I'll draft a 1-page IR runbook for service-account compromise: detection signals (sudden token usage from new IPs, high qps), containment steps (revoke tokens, rotate keys, denylist), evidence collection (export session logs, KMS audit, host forensics), and postmortem template. Short version below: 

```
IR playbook (sanitized):
1) Detect: alert on unusual SA activity (threshold + geo anomaly)
2) Contain: disable SA, revoke active tokens, trigger create of replacement SA
3) Collect: export audit for epoch, snapshot KMS audit, preserve instance disk images
4) Remediate: rotate keys, re-issue creds, re-run canary tests
5) Notify: customer + internal SRE + legal
6) Postmortem: timeline + actions + verification
```

Priya Nair: Perfect. Also note: Zebra requested proof that we do not retain customer plaintext in telemetry. Add the retention policy excerpt and the redact-policy file.

Alex Kim: For SIEM ingestion they want evidence we ship to the customer's SIEM or to a third-party. We can include a delivery log (syslog/HTTPS receipts) and a snapshot of the last 7 days of forwarded events for the tenant. Ops: is there a signed receipt we can hand over?

Sam Ortiz: Yes — forwarding component emits delivery receipts with sequence numbers. Example receipt: `{"tenant":"zebra","seq":1023456,"delivered_at":"2025-12-10T18:21:33Z","sha256":"..."}`. I'll include a sample and note the retention window.

Li Wei: One edge case: dedicated pool service accounts used for autoscaling have ephemeral credentials that don't appear in long-term IAM logs. We should call this out and show our autoscaler audit trail (scaling events + associated SA IDs).

Priya Nair: Action items / owners:
- Sam: produce signed audit export + sha256 manifest (due Thu EOD)
- Jordan: IAM change export for service accounts + annotation (Thu EOD)
- Li: KMS envelope metadata + rotation timeline + note on HSM attestations (Thu EOD)
- Maya: redact-policy excerpt + retention policy text (Wed)
- Alex: assemble bundle + one-pager on chain-of-custody + schedule 30m sync with Zebra (Fri)

Alex Kim: Scheduling: I can offer them Fri 11a PT or Mon 9a PT. Which works for ops? :calendar:

Priya Nair: Fri 11a PT works for me. Please add sec-bot summary to the call invite and mark items we won't be able to provide (e.g., no plaintext exports, vendor HSM certs may require extra ops time).

sec-bot: Reminder — file evidence bundles to /evidence-requests/zebra/ and set ACL to zebra-security@zebra.com once generated.

Maya Patel: Quick Q: do we need legal approval for the signed manifest? I think not, but flagging in case the export includes redacted PII.

Priya Nair: I'll loop in Legal if anything looks like PII. For now proceed with the exports and mark redacted fields in the manifest.

Jordan Lee: I'll post the export samples here when done. :+1:

Sam Ortiz: Will upload to /evidence-requests/zebra/ as zebra_audit_2025Q4.{ndjson,sha256} and ping once ready. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Thanks team — goal is to have a neat bundle and a short call where we can walk them through the artifacts, limitations, and next steps.

Alex Kim: Closing loop: I'll draft the 1-pager and attach to the meeting invite. Anything else?

Maya Patel: If Zebra also asks for PCI/ISO evidence, we'll need to map artifacts to their control IDs — file another ask if that comes up.

Priya Nair: Noted. For now let's finish the EOW artifacts. Thanks all. :rocket:
